description: Source code for the LSM6DSO16IS sensor driver, including interrupt handling, trigger setup, and GPIO configuration for a 6-axis IMU sensor.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_enable_t_int
methods.description: Enables or disables temperature interrupt pin.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_enable_xl_int
methods.description: Enables or disables accelerometer interrupt pin.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_enable_g_int
methods.description: Enables or disables gyroscope interrupt pin.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_trigger_set
methods.description: Links external trigger to data ready event.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles data ready interrupts, reads status, and calls registered handlers.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling GPIO interrupts (if configured).

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for global thread trigger handling.

methods.name: lsm6dso16is_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for data ready signals.
